title: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra
sanskrit: ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्। उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय मामृतात्॥
transliteration: Om Tryambakam Yajamahe Sugandhim Pushtivardhanam, Urvarukamiva Bandhanan Mrityor Mukshiya Maamritat.
meaning: We meditate upon the three-eyed Lord Shiva, whose divine presence nourishes and sustains all life. Just as a ripe cucumber effortlessly releases from its stalk, may we be gently liberated from spiritual bondage and fear of mortality into eternal peace.
practice_guide: Sit with an upright, relaxed spine. Close your eyes and chant along with steady, reverent awareness. With each repetition, feel any tension or fear quietly dissolve.
peace_benefit: May help cultivate courage, quiet anxious thoughts, and bring emotional steadiness during times of uncertainty.
sound_setting: Devotional Shiva Chant with 136.1 Hz Ambient Drone

title: Gayatri Mantra
sanskrit: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्॥
transliteration: Om Bhur Bhuvah Svah, Tat Savitur Varenyam, Bhargo Devasya Dhimahi, Dhiyo Yo Nah Prachodayat.
meaning: We meditate upon the supreme, self-luminous radiance of the Divine Creator Sun. May that divine light illuminate our intellect, dispel mental clouds, and guide our thoughts toward wisdom.
practice_guide: Ideally practiced facing morning light. Focus your gentle awareness at the center of the eyebrows (Ajna). Allow the rhythmic syllables to clear away morning lethargy.
peace_benefit: May support student focus, mental clarity, and clear discernment before studying or making decisions.
sound_setting: Solar Morning Chant with 432 Hz Tanpura Resonance

title: Mindful 5-Minute Pranayama & Breathwork
sanskrit: प्राणायामः परं तपः — Conscious breath is supreme inner purification.
transliteration: Inhale peace... Pause in stillness... Exhale gently... Release all strain.
meaning: Gentle, balanced breathing (inspired by Anulom Vilom and Box Breathing) that brings the sympathetic and parasympathetic nervous systems into natural harmony.
practice_guide: Follow the softly expanding visual circle below. Inhale comfortably through the nose for 4 seconds, pause gently for 2 seconds, and exhale slowly for 4 seconds without forcing your breath.
peace_benefit: May help ease rapid heartbeats, lower physical tension, and restore calm focus before study sessions or sleep.
sound_setting: Guided Breathing with Soft Air & 528 Hz Flow

title: Shanti Mantra (Prayer for Universal Peace)
sanskrit: ॐ द्यौः शान्तिरन्तरिक्षं शान्तिः पृथिवी शान्तिरापः शान्तिरोषधयः शान्तिः। वनस्पतयः शान्तिर्विश्वेदेवाः शान्तिर्ब्रह्म शान्तिः सर्वं शान्तिः शान्तिरेव शान्तिः सा मा शान्तिरेधि॥ ॐ शान्तिः शान्तिः शान्तिः॥
transliteration: Om Dyauh Shantir Antariksham Shantih, Prithivi Shantir Apah Shantir Oshadhayah Shantih, Vanaspatayah Shantir Vishvedevah Shantih, Brahma Shantih Sarvam Shantih, Shantir Eva Shantih Sa Ma Shantir Edhi. Om Shantih Shantih Shantih.
meaning: May there be peace in celestial realms, peace in the atmosphere, peace on earth, peace in waters, peace in herbs and trees, peace in all divinity, and peace across all creation. May that profound peace enter my heart. Om Peace, Peace, Peace.
practice_guide: Listen with hands resting gently on your lap. As you hear the prayer for universal harmony, consciously release any irritation or disagreement from your day.
peace_benefit: May help dissolve lingering friction from arguments, encourage forgiveness, and fill the mind with goodwill toward all beings.
sound_setting: Universal Vedic Chant with 396 Hz Peaceful Resonance

title: Evening Meditation: Gratitude & Letting Go
sanskrit: अहं साक्षी सर्वभूतानाम् — I am the calm, unattached witness of all experiences.
transliteration: I release the duties of today. I hold gratitude for lessons learned. My mind rests in quiet stillness.
meaning: An unhurried evening reflection: reviewing the day's actions with kindness, releasing worries about tomorrow, and resting in the steady stillness of your own consciousness.
practice_guide: Lie down or sit comfortably. Take a slow deep breath and silently acknowledge three things you are thankful for today. Then consciously give your mind permission to sleep and recharge.
peace_benefit: May help release screen fatigue, stop bedtime overthinking, and support deep, natural, restorative sleep.
sound_setting: Guided Spoken Evening Reflection with 432 Hz Drone
